claim: Gatus is a developer-oriented health dashboard configured by a single YAML file; supports Prometheus metrics via metrics:true; auto-reloads config on change; group: key organises endpoints on dashboard

claim: Uptime Kuma uses ~100 MB RAM; resource comparison table shows Kuma is more memory-intensive than Gatus

claim: Homepage has a native Gatus widget configured with type: gatus and url; displays up/down/uptime fields
